lines.text: In 1855, something reportedly walked over houses and left only hoofprints.

parts.tts: In eighteen fifty-five, something reportedly walked over houses and left only hoofprints.
parts.heard: In 1855, something reportedly walked over houses and left only hoofprints.

lines.text: Devon, England. One February night, after heavy snow.

parts.tts: Devon, England. One February night, after heavy snow.
parts.heard: Devon, England. One February night after heavy snow.

lines.text: By morning, hoof-like prints ran through the snow, mostly in single file.

parts.tts: By morning, hoof-like prints ran through the snow, mostly in single file.
parts.heard: By morning, hoof-like prints ran through the snow, mostly in single file.

lines.text: Each about 4 inches long. Reported in more than 30 places.

parts.tts: Each about four inches long. Reported in more than thirty places.
parts.heard: each about 4 inches long, reported in more than 30 places.

lines.text: But here's the part... the trail went straight over houses, walls and haystacks.

parts.tts: the trail went straight over houses, walls and haystacks.
parts.heard: The trail went straight over houses, walls, and haystacks.

lines.text: Over rivers. Across snowy rooftops. Even in and out of drainpipes.

parts.tts: Over rivers. Across snowy rooftops. Even in and out of drainpipes.
parts.heard: over rivers, across snowy rooftops, even in and out of drainpipes.

lines.text: In total: an estimated 40 to 100 miles of tracks.

parts.tts: In total: an estimated forty to one hundred miles of tracks.
parts.heard: In total, an estimated 40 to 100 miles of tracks.

lines.text: Some people said they were the tracks of Satan himself.

parts.tts: Some people said they were the tracks of Satan himself.
parts.heard: Some people said they were the tracks of Satan himself.

lines.text: Others blamed badgers, wood mice, escaped kangaroos... even a runaway balloon.

parts.tts: Others blamed badgers, wood mice, escaped kangaroos...
parts.heard: Others blamed badgers, wood mice, escaped kangaroos,

lines.text: But none of it has ever been confirmed. And some reports have been questioned.

parts.tts: But none of it has ever been confirmed. And some reports have been questioned.
parts.heard: but none of it has ever been confirmed, and some reports have been questioned.

lines.text: Over 170 years later, nobody knows what made the Devil's Footprints.
